title: A silly snail in a hat
done: You made a silly snail! It is very slow, and very fancy.

steps.say: Put a big orange square flat on the table. It is the snail's shell.
Put a yellow square next to it. That is the snail's body.
One more yellow square next to that. Now it has a head.
Put a small green triangle on top of the head. A feeler!
Put a blue triangle on top of the shell. Snails love hats.
